title: Magic Hud
description: Adds fully customizable HUD widgets for armor, sprint, potion effects, FPS, ping, and other utilities.
body:
**Magic HUD** is a lightweight, fully customizable heads-up display mod for Minecraft. Instead of cluttering your screen with information you didn't ask for, it gives you full control over what you see, where you see it, and how big it is — without ever touching a config file.</br>
Open the HUD editor with a single keybind, drag your modules wherever feels right, resize them on the fly, and close it. That's it. Everything saves automatically.

What's included</br>
Every module is independent — enable only what you need:</br>
    **Armor Status** — tracks your equipped armor and durability at a glance</br>
    **Inventory HUD** — keeps an eye on your hotbar without opening your inventory</br>
     **Potion Effects** — shows active effects, their level, and remaining duration
     </br>
     **Coordinates** — displays X/Y/Z and your facing direction in real time
     </br>
     **FPS Counter** — clean and always visible
     </br>
   **Ping Display** — useful for servers where connection quality matters
     </br>
     **Toggle Sprint** — keeps you sprinting automatically </br> </br>
**How it works**</br>
Press the editor keybind to enter edit mode. Every active module shows up with a selection frame — drag it anywhere on screen, grab the resize handle in the corner to scale it up or down, then close the editor and keep playing. Modules also adapt automatically if you change your GUI Scale or window resolution, so nothing ever ends up hidden off-screen.</br>
Each module has a few settings you can tweak (like toggling the background panel or adjusting the scale numerically), accessible through the module settings screen.

**Design philosophy**</br>
Magic HUD is intentionally minimal. No animations, no bloat, no forced aesthetic. The dark rounded panels blend into most resource packs without getting in the way. You can turn backgrounds off entirely if you prefer floating text.
